title: Rory and the Quiet Cloud Lagoon
verses:
The shadows were long on the mosses below,
The stars gave a comforting light,
Where Rory stepped gently with rhythms so slow,
To welcome the quiet of night.

High over the branches did Nia swoosh by,
While Ricky stopped skipping ahead,
To gaze at the colors that painted the sky,
Like blankets of purple and red.

Then Tilly found petals of lavender blue,
That floated right down to the glade,
Where Psittaco gathered a blossom or two,
Beneath the tall shelter of shade.

Then Rory sat down where the grasses were sweet,
And felt the cool breath of the breeze,
With soft velvet clover right under his feet,
That rustled beneath the tall trees.

They gathered together to build a soft nest,
Where moonlight fell cozy and deep,
And Ricky curled up for a wonderful rest,
While Psittaco drifted to sleep.

With Nia asleep on the moss of the hill,
Good night to the stars and the stream,
Now Benny and Tilly and Rory were still,
All drifting away in a dream.
